findings.title: Proximity explanations use metadata only
findings.detail: 6-feature decomposition uses language, branch, legal_area, citation_overlap, text_length, date_proximity. No deep text similarity (TF-IDF cosine, semantic embeddings).
findings.impact: Explanations are interpretable but shallow. State correctly documents this and lists deep text similarity as next step.

findings.title: Language dominance visible but not resolved
findings.detail: Proximity explainer correctly identifies and warns about language dominance (0.982 baseline), but the underlying map still clusters primarily by language. Diagnostic tool, not remedial.
findings.impact: Users understand WHY proximity is language-driven but cannot yet switch to language-invariant view. Section modes partially address but cover 6.3%.
